intended_use: Decision support for limb X-ray review: zero-shot prompts for fracture and other abnormality. Hip and pelvis are experimental and must be labelled degraded.
training_data: SigLIP 2 image-text pretraining on public web data. Not fine-tuned on bone radiographs; MIAP uses text prompts to score findings, so thresholds are not clinically calibrated.
validation: No clinical validation on Ugandan or local patients and no threshold tuning. The local CPU gate (2026-11-10) passed on a hand fixture: mean 0.331 s, 3.43 s first result including a 224x224 Grad-CAM, 2.1 GB peak RSS, recorded in ml/benchmark/siglip_bone_benchmark.json. Speed and CAM sanity only, not accuracy.
limitations: Zero-shot scores are uncalibrated and may change with prompt wording.
Hip and pelvis are experimental; results are marked degraded with an extra caveat.
Paediatric, post-surgical and hardware images are out of scope.
The heatmap shows where the model looked, not proof of a fracture.
A negative result does not exclude a fracture; review the full series.
intended_population: Adults with a limb radiograph; not validated for children or complex trauma.
input: Single radiograph, centre crop resized to 224x224, grey replicated to three channels, mean/std 0.5.
output: Zero-shot prompt scores with a Grad-CAM from the last encoder block, reshaped from tokens.
ethical_notes: Experimental on hip and pelvis. Always state the limitation in the report.
